moderationDesk.title: Moderation
moderationDesk.lead: The DIASPORALE report queue, by country and by content type. Every decision is reasoned, recorded in the engine's decision log and open to appeal.
moderationDesk.demoNotice: Demonstration: cases, appeals and teams are fictitious. Your decisions stay in this browser and have no effect on posts or people.

unavailable.title: Moderation is not available here
unavailable.body: This space is reserved for the network's authorised moderation teams. If you think you should have access, contact the network administration.

role.network_admin: You administer the network: you read the whole queue, review appeals and compose teams.
role.network_moderator: You moderate the network: you read the whole accessible queue and decide its cases.
role.team_member: You moderate within a team: you read your teams' queue and decide their cases.

capacity.noTeam: You are not part of any team.
capacity.decisions: A party to a case (author, reporter, signatory of the page concerned, previous decision-maker) does not decide it.

filters.label: Queue filters
filters.countryNote: The country is that of the reported content (local post, page, event, offer area), never that of a person. The engine does not yet attach a team to a country: this filter defines no remit.

ground.deepfake_of_me: Deepfake of a person without consent

party.title: You do not decide this case
party.author: You are the author of the content concerned.
party.page: You sign for the page this content belongs to.
party.handOver: Another team member must decide it.

queue.title: Case queue
queue.lead: Open cases within your remit, oldest first.
queue.emptyBody: Your queue is empty for now.
queue.emptyFilteredBody: Try another country or type: diaspora-wide content is filed under “no country”.
queue.emptyPendingBody: Pages, events and content held before publication appear here.

case.title: Case: {{surface}}
case.description: The content concerned as the engine projects it, previous decisions and your decision.
case.closed: This case is no longer open: it has already been decided, or it is no longer within your remit.

preview.title: Preview
preview.bounded: Only the content concerned is shown: not its author, the reporter, contact details or private documents.
preview.gone: The preview is no longer available: the case has been decided or is no longer within your remit.
preview.error: The preview could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
preview.unavailable: The content is no longer available (removed, erased or out of reach).
preview.empty: This content has no text or media.

history.title: Previous decisions on this content
history.empty: No previous decision accessible on this content.
history.more: Other previous decisions exist; only the most recent are shown.

decision.title: Your decision

outcomeHint.dismissed: The report is unfounded: nothing changes for the content or the person.
outcomeHint.actioned: You choose each measure to apply.

decision.measuresLead: Choose at least one measure: nothing is applied by default.
decision.personHint: A suspension or an exclusion applies across the network and at the ANTSIA root.
decision.noAuthor: No person is targeted by this content: only its removal applies.
decision.reasonHint: Required, {{min}} to {{max}} characters. The person concerned will read it: do not include contact details or private data.

done.dismissed: Case dismissed: it has left the queue.
done.actioned: Decision saved: the case has left the queue.

confirm.title: Confirm a heavy measure
confirm.everywhere: A suspension or an exclusion applies across the network and at the ANTSIA root, until it ends or an appeal succeeds.
confirm.appeal: The decision is reasoned by your text and is open to appeal.
confirm.rejectBody: Rejecting removes this content ({{surface}}): it will not be published.
confirm.overturnBody: Overturning the decision lifts its measures and restores the content if it had been removed.

pending.title: Review: {{surface}}
pending.description: Content held before publication: approve or reject it, with a reason.
pending.approveHint: The content is published to its audience.
pending.rejectHint: The content is not published; its author, if any, is notified.
pending.doneApproved: Content approved: it has left the review.
pending.doneRejected: Content rejected: it has left the review.

appeals.title: Appeals to review
appeals.lead: Appeals against a team decision, oldest first. Neither the previous decision-maker nor the person appealing reviews them.
appeals.restricted: Reviewing appeals is reserved for the network administration.
appeals.emptyBody: An appeal appears here when a person contests a team decision.
appeals.sheetDescription: The contested decision, the reason for the appeal, then your reasoned review.
appeals.upholdHint: The decision and its measures stay in force; the person can still turn to the platform team.
appeals.overturnHint: The measures are lifted and the content is restored if it had been removed.
appeals.doneUpheld: Decision upheld: the appeal has left the queue.
appeals.doneOverturned: Decision overturned: the appeal has left the queue.

team.title: Moderation teams
team.lead: The teams handling the network queue and the people in charge.
team.countryNote: The engine does not yet attach a team to a country: a team name may say so, it defines no remit.
team.noTeam: You are not part of any team.
team.noTeamNetworkWide: You are not part of any team: your network role opens the whole accessible queue to you.
team.readOnly: Team composition is managed by the network administration.
team.noneYet: No team exists yet: create the first one below.
team.rosterEmpty: This team has no active member yet.
team.rosterMore: Other members exist; only the first ones are shown.
team.outsideNetwork: No longer an active network member.
team.removeBody: This person will no longer read the {{team}} team queue. The removal is reasoned and recorded in the engine's decision log.
team.removed: {{name}} is no longer part of the team.
team.addTitle: Add a member to the {{name}} team
team.handleHint: For example firstname.lastname: only an active network member can be added.
team.added: {{name}} is now part of the team.
team.createLead: A team handles every content type or a single one; creating it requires a reason.
team.name: Team name

errors.moderation_desk_reason_length: The reason must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters.
errors.moderation_desk_duration_required: Choose a duration for this measure.
errors.moderation_desk_measure_refused: This measure does not apply to this case (no person targeted, or duration refused).
errors.moderation_desk_conflict: The case changed in the meantime: it has probably been decided already. Reread the queue.
errors.moderation_desk_limit: The engine refuses this action for now (limit reached or restriction in progress).
errors.moderation_desk_party: You are a party to this case: another team member must decide it.
errors.moderation_desk_team_name_length: The team name must be between {{nameMin}} and {{nameMax}} characters.
errors.moderation_desk_member_unknown: No active network member has this handle.
